london-kent-downs-and-white-cliffs.title: London · Kent Downs and White Cliffs
london-kent-downs-and-white-cliffs.slogan: A 293 km loop out of Westerham lanes
london-kent-downs-and-white-cliffs.story: Shorter miles, sharp views and coastal punctuation. Out of Westerham and back again: 293 km, roughly 5 h 03 in the saddle. On the way it passes Canterbury, Dover White Cliffs, Folkestone coast and Royal Tunbridge Wells. The coast is the point of it.

scenicChapters.title: Dover White Cliffs → Folkestone coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 23 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
